name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for home repair estimates?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for home repair estimates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting an estimate, list every repair item in your home, note when the issues began, and take clear photos of the damaged areas. If you are dealing with water leaks, storm damage, or cracked tiles, check whether the source of the issue has been resolved or if it requires inspection. Having clear measurements and noting access points—such as whether the repair is on a high ceiling or in a tight basement—helps contractor Abraham Becerra assess the tools, drywall materials, and crew time needed. Grouping multiple small repairs into one visit also lowers your total labor expense.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compile a complete list of damaged areas, take clear photos, confirm if active leaks have stopped, and note access challenges to help the contractor provide an accurate quote.
